main_text.l: Ferar, fereris vel ferere, feretur, feremur, feremini,
Amatus, Doctus, Lectus, Auditus, Latus ero vel
fuero, ich will oder werde / oder soll geliebet / geleh-
erit vel fuerit, Amati, docti, lecti, auditi, lati erimus
vel fuerimus, eritis vel fueritis, erunt vel fuerint.
Amare vel amator tu, werde du geliebet oder du
sollt geliebet werden/ amator ille, amamini vos, a-
Docere vel docetor tu, docetor ille, docemini vos,
Legere vel legitor tu, legitor ille, legimini vos, le-
Audire vel auditor tu, auditor ille, audimini vos,
Ferre vel fertor tu, fertor ille; ferimini vos, ferun-
Amari, geliebet werden. Doceri, gelehret werden.
Legi, gelesen werden. Audiri, gehöret werden. Ferri,

page.notes: The German glosses are in black letter and are marked with bl; the exact extent of the bl spans is uncertain in places. The "ut" connector is set sideways between the brackets and is read as a label. The depth of the right-hand boxes in the diagram is inferred from the brace layout and is not certain. The "ilh" in "amantor illi" and the "ilii" in "docentor illi" are read as printed and may be damaged. No signature, catchword or margin notes are visible.
